subject: Conditional retention adjudication & proof-of-delete process
messages:
From: Ben Thorpe <bthorpe@coredx.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.example.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example.com>
Cc: CoreDX Legal <legal@coredx.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Temporary retention carveout + proof-of-delete workflow

Hi Mateo / Irene,

Quick one — our security team just flagged a customer forensic requirement for a specific tenant (tenant id: CDX-776). For a subset of debug/session logs they need 120 days preserved for an ongoing clinical investigation; our default is 30 days.

We understand this is a deviation. Can Redwood:
- Confirm whether a tenant-scoped retention carveout is supportable for hosted customers (metadata + logs only)
- Provide the exact artifacts you would produce as "proof of delete" for the non-exempted logs when the investigation closes
- Tell us what evidence (SIG/Caiq/SOC2) we can attach to our audit packet to justify the temporary variance

Attached is the internal request form the auditor filled out (requested-retention-exception-form.pdf).

Ben
Security Operations | CoreDX Health
Attachments: requested-retention-exception-form.pdf
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.example.com>
To: Ben Thorpe <bthorpe@coredx.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary retention carveout + proof-of-delete workflow

Thanks Ben — tagging our security/compliance feed.

Short answer: yes, we can support a tenant-scoped temporary retention variance in hosted, but it requires a controlled approval and an evidence package to meet SIG/SOC2 expectations. High-level plan:
1) We create a timeboxed policy override for the tenant (120d for the named log categories).
2) We stage a cryptographic "proof of delete" pipeline: manifest + signed deletion receipts + truncated index sample.
3) We provide an attestation bundle (redacted manifests, retention_decision_matrix.pdf, and a short SOC2-aligned note) for auditors.

Can you confirm the exact log categories and whether CoreDX needs any raw KV cache dumps? If so, we need legal sign-off (please loop legal if not already done).

Deliverables and timeline I propose: 72 hours to produce an evidence pack (initial artifacts + attestation). If you approve, we'll preserve affected objects in an escrow bucket until you confirm closure.

I'll loop in Irene to scope attachments and redaction rules.

— Mateo
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.example.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 13:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Temporary retention carveout + proof-of-delete workflow

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Ben Thorpe <bthorpe@coredx.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 at 09:12 AM
Subject: Request: Temporary retention carveout + proof-of-delete workflow
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.example.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example.com>
Cc: CoreDX Legal <legal@coredx.com>

(I forwarded to the team)

Irene / Soojin — need your input on the exact artifacts we can produce. Proposed minimal evidence set:
- signed deletion receipts (per object) OR a signed manifest showing object ids and deletion timestamp
- sample exported index (first/last X bytes) with PII redacted
- retention_decision_matrix.pdf describing why the carveout was granted and controls applied

Questions for triage:
- Does the signed-deletion approach require custom KMS operations or can we rely on our existing HSM signing key?
- Can we produce a downloadable CSV manifest with object ids that the customer can cross-reference? (Proof_of_delete_manifest.csv)
- Any concerns from infra about preserving objects in an escrow bucket for 120d (cost + access controls)?

Soojin / Irene — please advise and list the minimal redaction steps so we can send back to legal / the auditor.

— Mateo

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.example.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Temporary retention carveout + proof-of-delete workflow

Agree with Mateo's approach. My notes / constraints:
- We can sign manifests with our HSM (no custom KMS ops). The manifest will include object ids, SHA256, retention window, and deletion ETA. We'll cryptographically sign that file.
- For auditor consumption we should produce:
  * proof_of_delete_manifest.csv (object_id, sha256, original_ttl_days, carveout_days) — redacted where necessary
  * deletion_receipts.zip (contains small per-object receipts; we can provide a sampled subset if security/legal requests minimal PII exposure)
  * retention_decision_matrix.pdf explaining controls, reviewers, and timestamps
- Redaction: redact customer PII fields in index exports; provide a short redaction manifest showing what was removed and why (redaction-sample.txt).
- Escrow: infra will snapshot objects to an escrow bucket with strict ACLs and logging. Cost estimate: ~0.4 TB-month for this tenant for 120 days; ops approves with written sign-off from legal.

Action items:
- Mateo: confirm to Ben that we will produce the attestation package within 72 hours and request legal sign-off for escrow storage.
- Soojin: produce the signed-manifest template and retention_decision_matrix.pdf draft.

— Irene
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: redaction-sample.txt
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.example.com>
To: Ben Thorpe <bthorpe@coredx.com>, CoreDX Legal <legal@coredx.com>, AuditsOps <audits@coredx.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary retention carveout + proof-of-delete workflow — next steps and deliverables

Ben / CoreDX team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our internal review, here is what Redwood will deliver and the expected timeline: 

Deliverables (will be shared via a secure drive link):
- retention_decision_matrix.pdf (control rationale + approvers)
- proof_of_delete_manifest.csv (signed with Redwood HSM) — includes object ids and SHA256; PII fields redacted
- deletion_receipts.zip (sampled receipts + instructions for verification)
- SOC2-note.txt (short note describing controls applied to the variance that auditors can reference)

Timeline:
- We will provision the tenant-scoped 120d retention override within 6 hours of Legal approval.
- Evidence pack (initial artifacts above) will be ready within 72 hours after you confirm legal approval for escrow storage.

Please confirm: 1) the list of log categories to include (e.g., app-debug, session-trace, routing-metrics) and 2) that CoreDX Legal approves escrow storage (legal@coredx.com). Once we have that confirmation, we'll run the change and share the secure link to the attestation bundle.

Attachments we will include: retention_decision_matrix.pdf, proof_of_delete_manifest.csv, deletion_receipts.zip, redaction-sample.txt

Thanks — we'll keep logs immutable in a protected escrow container until you instruct us to delete after the investigation closes.

— Mateo
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | https://www.redwood.ai
